title: Letting Models Manage Their Own Context: Where We Stand
abstract: arXiv:2611.34147v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent harnesses today manage context on the model's behalf: when the window fills, the harness triggers a compaction that summarizes the history. We study the alternative, \emph{model-driven} context management, in which the model itself decides when and what to compact through a context API. We gave models control over their own context in \nooa, NVIDIA's open source agent harness, and compared the two strategies on document research and machine learning engineering across context budgets from 8K to 512K tokens. Models that use the context API effectively reach higher accuracy, often with fewer input tokens, especially at tight budgets: \textbf{GPT 6.1 nearly triples its score at a 32K budget} on OfficeQA Pro v2 (21\%~$\rightarrow$~56\%), and \textbf{Kimi gains with up to 41\% fewer input tokens}. translated_title: 让模型管理自己的上下文：现状综述
translated_abstract: 当今的智能体框架都是代替模型来管理上下文：当上下文窗口被填满时，框架会触发一次压缩操作，对历史记录进行摘要总结。我们研究了另一种方式——模型驱动的上下文管理，即模型自身通过上下文API来决定何时压缩以及压缩哪些内容。我们在NVIDIA的开源智能体框架Nooa中让模型掌控自己的上下文，并在8K到512K token的不同上下文预算下，针对文档研究和机器学习工程两类任务对两种策略进行了比较。能够有效使用上下文API的模型达到了更高的准确率，且往往消耗更少的输入token，尤其在预算紧张的情况下表现突出：在OfficeQA Pro v2上，GPT 6.1在32K预算下的得分几乎提升至三倍（21% → 56%），而Kimi在输入token减少多达41%的情况下仍取得了提升。然而，不同模型在使用API的频率、压缩的激进程度以及开始压缩的时机上差异很大，并且提示词的更改……
tldr: 研究发现，让模型通过上下文API自主决定何时压缩及压缩哪些内容，相比由智能体框架代管的上下文压缩策略能显著提升准确率并减少输入token消耗，尤其是在上下文预算紧张的情况下效果最为明显。
en_tdlr: Letting models manage their own context via a context API achieves higher accuracy with often fewer input tokens than harness-driven compaction, with the largest gains under tight context budgets.
